violations.why: ISR can write v_vessel between the task's write and its later read in fn_iris.
ISR resets v_vessel after the check, so the task writes 12 based on a stale read.
ISR write can occur between the check and the else-branch write, which acts on stale data.
ISR overwrites the 12 the task just stored before the task reads it in fn_raptor.
ISR write can intervene between the task's write and its later read.
The two reads of v_vessel (lines 50 and 22) can see different values if the ISR writes in between.
